tasks.name: Fix pagination off-by-one
tasks.prompt: Users report that page 1 from `paginate` in src/paginate.ts skips the first items. Pages are 1-based. Fix the bug and add a regression test in src/paginate.test.ts.

tasks.name: Implement a generic Go stack
tasks.prompt: Implement the generic Stack[T] type in stack.go as documented in the comments (Push, Pop, Peek, Len, IsEmpty). Pop and Peek on an empty stack return the zero value and false. Add tests and run `go test ./...`.

tasks.name: Fix a Python duration parser
tasks.prompt: `parse_duration` in duration.py should convert strings like '1h30m', '45s', '2h', '1h2m3s' into total seconds, but mixed units give wrong results. Fix it and verify with pytest.

tasks.name: Fix a Rust crate that does not compile and has a logic bug
tasks.prompt: This Rust crate does not compile, and once it does, `cargo test` has a failing test. Make it compile and fix the logic so all tests pass. Do not change the tests.

tasks.name: Debug a failing test whose cause is in another module
tasks.prompt: `bun test` fails in tests/checkout.test.ts. Find the root cause and fix it. Do not modify the tests.

tasks.name: Implement an LRU cache from a spec
tasks.prompt: Implement the LRU cache described in SPEC.md. Write your own tests in src/lru.test.ts and make sure they pass.

tasks.name: Rename a function across a codebase
tasks.prompt: Rename the function `getUserName` to `getDisplayName` everywhere (definition, all call sites, imports, tests). Keep behaviour identical and make sure `bun test` passes.

grader.cmd: bun test && ! grep -rn getUserName src tests

tasks.name: Write tests that catch real bugs
tasks.prompt: Write a thorough test suite for `slugify` (src/slugify.ts) in src/slugify.test.ts. It must pass against the current implementation and should catch regressions: accents, case, punctuation runs, leading/trailing separators, digits, empty input.
